+import os

+def get_config(config=None):

+    if "project_id" not in merged:

+    merged.setdefault("location", os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION", "global"))

+def get_translation_client(config=None):

+def batch_translate_payload(payload):
+    return [{"text": text, "index": index} for index, text in enumerate(payload["texts"])]

+
+def batch_translate_result(translations, items, payload):
+    return {
+        "texts": [translation.translated_text for translation in translations],
+        "source_language": payload["source_language"],
+        "target_language": payload["target_language"],
+        "order": [item["index"] for item in items],
+    }

+def markup_translate_payload(payload):

+from google.cloud import language_v1
+
+from translation_client import get_config
+
+
+def quality_summary(payload, config=None):
+    config = get_config(config)
+    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()
+    document = language_v1.Document(content=payload["text"], type_=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
+    sentiment = client.analyze_sentiment(request={"document": document, "encoding_type": language_v1.EncodingType.UTF8})
+    return {
+        "score": sentiment.document_sentiment.score,
+        "magnitude": sentiment.document_sentiment.magnitude,
+        "issues": ["low_sentiment"] if sentiment.document_sentiment.score < 0 else [],
+        "source_language": payload["source_language"],
+        "target_language": payload["target_language"],
+        "project_id": config["project_id"],

+from google.cloud import language_v1
+
+from translation_client import get_config
+
+
+def unsafe_copy_check(payload, config=None):
+    config = get_config(config)
+    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()
+    document = language_v1.Document(content=payload["text"], type_=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
+    analysis = client.analyze_entities(request={"document": document, "encoding_type": language_v1.EncodingType.UTF8})
+    flagged = [entity.name for entity in analysis.entities if entity.salience > 0.2]
+    return {
+        "flagged_terms": flagged,
+        "source_language": payload["source_language"],
+        "target_language": payload["target_language"],
+        "project_id": config["project_id"],
+    }
